fields.summary_ko.0: The AI data storage market is expected to grow from $44.9 billion in 2026 to $271.3 billion in 2034 at a compound annual rate of 25.2%, with Seagate Technology (STX) and Micron Technology (MU) as beneficiary companies.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate recorded Q1 revenue of $4.23 billion (60% year-over-year increase), non-GAAP EPS of $7.68, and free cash flow of $1.5 billion, with Q2 guidance of $4.8 billion revenue (±$100 million) and EPS of $9.20 (±20 cents).
fields.summary_ko.2: STX's HAMR-based Mozaic roadmap targets 50% shipment achievement by end of 2026, securing revenue visibility through long-term supply contracts by 2030, with plans to allocate 75% of free cash flow to share buybacks.
